name: awesome-hud
description: Animated pixel mascots under the prompt that react to what Claude is doing, with themed sounds and a compact status bar

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Who sits by the prompt: cat, an orange cat with opinions; chibi, big eyes and anime feelings; got, a direwolf of the North. /awesome-hud <theme> sets this too.

position.title: Position
position.description: below draws the mascot and status bar under the prompt, after Claude Code's hint line; above draws them over the prompt, where they make way for Claude Code's surveys.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: full draws the mascot beside five rows of stats; compact draws the stats alone on two lines, with no mascot.

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: A short theme sound when Claude finishes a turn of 30 seconds or more, hits an error, needs your OK, or a party starts. macOS plays it through Claude Code; Linux needs pw-play, paplay or aplay.

cost.title: Session cost
cost.description: auto shows the cost off a Pro or Max plan and hides it on one, where it is an API-price estimate rather than a bill; show and hide decide for you.

flavorText.title: Themed words
flavorText.description: Theme words in Claude Code's own spinner and turn-closing line, and a toast when tests pass or a commit or push lands. Off, only the band is themed.

prStatus.title: PR status
prStatus.description: The branch's pull request beside its git state, with its checks and review, from GitHub's CLI (gh pr view): after a push, and every five minutes while you are about. Off, the band names a pull request only once Claude opens or changes one. The one part of the mod that uses the network.
